commands_run: python -m unittest python.codeflow_ml.test_experiments python.codeflow_ml.test_runtime python.codeflow_ml.test_workflows python.codeflow_ml.test_baselines -v
tests: 10 combined tests passed, including dataset manifest checksums and lineage, deterministic train/validation/test splitting, experiment metadata, runtime, workflow, feature, and ML regressions

benchmark_outcomes.name: one-command offline reproduction
benchmark_outcomes.details: The documented unittest command reproduces all current Python experiment checks without network or LLM services.

known_limitations: MLflow integration is represented by serializable local experiment metadata because no tracking service is required for offline execution.
schema_changes: Added DatasetManifest, deterministic_split, and experiment_record APIs.
